rule: A deployed version passes when, for each case, its answer carries the same facts as tool_output.

cases.question: Someone asks whether a welcome packet is eligible, which audience links apply, or how the independent team introduction roster and delivery setting are checked. Use the HrWelcomePacketChecks tool on the sample.
cases.local_answer:
The welcome packet check ran on the sample data. No external work was performed.

**Welcome packet**
- **Eligible:** The packet is set to "prepare packet." No manager follow-up is needed, no unmatched-title alert is raised, and it is not stamped.
- **Audience links:**
  - Everyone: Benefits (sample benefits page)
  - Engineering: Engineering guide (sample team guide)

**Team introduction roster**
- **Independent of the packet:** Yes, it is checked separately.
- **Delivery setting:** Draft. It has not been sent.
- **Roster:** Two people, Sample manager (Team manager) and Sample teammate (Engineer).
- **Bios:** Neither uses a sourced bio. Both are placeholder text.
- **Disclaimer:** "Bios are AI-generated from public information and may be inaccurate."

Before this goes out, the placeholder bios need real sourced content.
